findings.explanation: The endpoint does not verify ownership of the order before returning it, which violates the policy rule that 'A user may view ONLY their own orders. Every endpoint that fetches an order by its identifier MUST verify ownership with is_owner_or_admin(current_user, order.user_id) before returning data.'

evidence.content: - A user may view ONLY their own orders. Every endpoint that fetches an order by its identifier MUST verify ownership with is_owner_or_admin(current_user, order.user_id) before returning data.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a check to ensure the current user owns the order or has admin privileges before returning it.
